tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Should Provide Purchase Order for Supply of Unique Plants worth Rs.5.00 Crores during the year 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 (Cumulative) to any Government or Government Undertaking Sectors by the Firm or by his collaboration firm.
Tenderer should have Valid Import License or Should obtain Authorization Letter from any Firm having valid Import License.

Tenderer should provide photo proof of having Unique Tree Plants in the Nursery. The same will be inspected by the Departmental Officers for having Unique Tree Plants in the Nursery, after confirming the proof then only Technical bid will be Accepted.
